question: In its answer to question E-001052/20251, the Commission did not say whether the Coordinator on combating anti-Muslim hatred had worked with FEMYSO and, if so, whether the Commission continued to cooperate with the organisation. 1.
Has the Coordinator on combating anti-Muslim hatred been working with FEMYSO and, if she has, is she continuing to do so?
Can the Commission confirm that FEMYSO’s proximity to the Muslim Brotherhood is not compatible with fundamental European values?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (12.9.2025) Since her appointment in 2023, the Coordinator on combatting anti-Muslim hatred has not met bilaterally with FEMYSO or actively engaged with them.

Member States, in particular those where an association is established, have the competence to investigate where justified whether it has links with specific movements and whether such movements are unlawful, taking into account the need to respect the core values of the EU including freedom of association, freedom of expression and freedom of religion and belief.
